'''Antamont''' was a nonindustrial, mountainous [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Antamont system/Legends|Antamont system]] of the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]].

==History==
Antamont became the site of a stronghold of the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In an attempt to take the farming world, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched an [[Battle of Antamont|attack]] on the world using an army of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and [[B2 grapple droid/Legends|B2 grapple droids]] to smash the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The most significant event during the battle was the "awakening" experienced by a [[Lone battle droid|single]] B1 droid after it was severely damaged following the detention of a [[Mine/Legends|mine]]. Cut off from the [[droid control program]], the droid was free to activate its self-preservation software and defect from the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. One of the Grapple droids followed the rogue droid and attempted to take it back into the army. However, after a brief skirmish, both droids toppled off of a cliff. Damaged and cut off from its control program, the Grapple droid felt fear as it began to shut down. The B1 droid offered its condolences and stood beside the wrecked machine as its cogs slowed to a halt. The lone droid walked up onto a nearby hill and sat under a solitary tree as it ran out of power. The battle that raged on the world diminished, resulting in a Republic victory, and the droid was never recovered by either army.<ref name="CWA8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Antamont was created for the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|Clone Wars Adventures]] story ''[[Pathways]]'', published in [[2007]]. While originally unnamed, it was first identified in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and was later given coordinates in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
